source_review.article_title: Herber Rückschlag in der MSA-Forschung: Teva beendet Phase-2-Studie TOPAS-MSA mit Emrusolmin vorzeitig
source_review.source_access: Public addressed Mastodon post and linked German article read in browser; official Teva release read through web search/open. No source body or screenshot retained.
source_review.identity: Emrusolmin (TEV-56286, anle138b) for multiple system atrophy in adults. Main trial NCT06568237, separate open-label extension NCT07197866. Primary registry payloads and timestamps retained privately in msa-primary-records.json.
source_review.status_limit: Teva announced discontinuation of TOPAS-MSA following interim futility, not final efficacy results or a decision on the entire programme. Current registry payloads still say ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING for TOPAS-MSA and RECRUITING for its extension. Preserve the registry-derived status and explicitly date the reported discontinuation in the summary; do not fabricate a terminated event or a human-only failure flag.
source_review.duplicate_check: No published or private claim found under emrusolmin, anle138b or 56286 on 2026-11-16.
source_review.private_work: Prepared once through the normal workflow (131 seconds). Approved claim 575 and early-human stage as assistant; rejected wrong organisation candidate 17999 as assistant. Normal non-preview export staged with one new card and all 174 existing cards unchanged. Not yet released.

approved.scope: TOPAS-MSA: oral TEV-56286/emrusolmin in adults aged 30–75 with multiple system atrophy, phase 2; 349 actual participants; placebo control; two 48-week symptom-score primary outcomes.
Separate open-label extension of TEV-56286 in adults aged 30+ with multiple system atrophy, phase 2; 200 planned participants; two 100-week safety primary outcomes.

trial_review.excluded_reason: Five healthy-volunteer studies and one Parkinson disease study do not test this claim indication. Six candidates rejected by rule; scores and original records retained.
trial_review.events: Four approved registry registration/start events only. No results, termination, regulatory approval or failure flag invented from the press release.
trial_review.readings: Eight structured readings retain two 48-week symptom endpoints and two 100-week safety endpoints; no efficacy result is inferred.
